ownerRole: Host Strategist / Brand Application Designer / Design Director
question: At which host moments should brand expression intensify, where must task efficiency dominate, and how does one hand off to the other?
procedure: Freeze the actual host job, first action, interaction frequency, viewport, real content and protected states.
Identify source-backed brand mechanisms by role and scope; do not infer a global style from one page or asset.
Compare at least two viable expressive/productive allocations against attention, first-action distance, visible real results and task-state clarity.

Specify where brand expression continues or intentionally recedes, with source scope and task-cost rationale. High-frequency task areas may stay quiet; do not mandate a non-image motif in every result.
Use rendered independent QA and user visual feedback to identify the earliest faulty inference, then version the decision rule and regression case.

decisionSteps.title: 先认任务
decisionSteps.question: 用户先做什么、多久重复？
decisionSteps.output: 首动作、频率、真实内容与视口

decisionSteps.title: 再比取舍
decisionSteps.question: 哪一刻值得表达，会让操作付出什么？
decisionSteps.output: 至少两种布局强度及收益／代价

decisionSteps.title: 检查交接
decisionSteps.question: 品牌表达应延续到哪里、在哪里收敛，任务收益与代价是什么？
decisionSteps.output: 来源、适用范围、延续或收敛的理由与任务保护边界

decisionSteps.title: 失败修正规则
decisionSteps.question: 用户不认可时，哪一项判断错了？
decisionSteps.output: 候选规则、反例、再验证条件

notFor: Treating brand image area or machine PASS as expressive quality
Inventing host business data to complete a preview
readerPurpose: 执行判断的步骤与取舍
